tools.name: compare_meta_campaigns
tools.description: Compare performance metrics side-by-side for multiple Meta campaigns

tools.name: get_ad_research_detail
tools.description: Inspect one ad from ads research and return its creative, metrics, and reusable pattern explanation.

tools.name: get_ads_ad_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for a single ad on any connected ads platform (Meta ad, Google Ads ad, TikTok ad, or X ad) through the platform-generic ads gateway

tools.name: get_ads_adset_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for one ad set on any connected ads platform (Meta ad set, Google Ads ad group, TikTok ad group, or X ad group) through the platform-generic ads gateway

tools.name: get_google_ads_adgroup_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for a Google Ads ad group

tools.name: get_google_ads_campaign_metrics
tools.description: Get detailed metrics for a Google Ads campaign including impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, CTR, and CPC

tools.name: get_google_ads_keyword_performance
tools.description: Get keyword performance report with quality scores, clicks, impressions, and cost

tools.name: get_google_ads_search_terms
tools.description: Get search terms report showing actual search queries that triggered your ads

tools.name: get_meta_ad_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for an individual Meta ad including creative details

tools.name: get_meta_adset_insights
tools.description: Get performance insights for a Meta ad set

tools.name: get_meta_campaign_insights
tools.description: Get detailed performance insights for a Meta ad campaign including spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, and conversions

tools.name: get_meta_top_performers
tools.description: Get top performing Meta ads sorted by a specific metric (CTR, ROAS, CPC, etc.)

tools.name: get_tiktok_campaign_insights
tools.description: Get detailed performance insights for a TikTok ad campaign including spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, and conversions

tools.name: list_ads_research
tools.description: List top-performing public and connected ads by niche, platform, source, metric, and timeframe.

tools.name: list_google_ads_campaigns
tools.description: List Google Ads campaigns with optional status filter

tools.name: list_google_ads_customers
tools.description: List accessible Google Ads customer accounts

tools.name: list_meta_ad_accounts
tools.description: List connected Meta (Facebook) ad accounts

tools.name: list_meta_ad_creatives
tools.description: List creative assets (headlines, body text, CTAs, images) for Meta ads

tools.name: list_meta_campaigns
tools.description: List Meta ad campaigns with optional status filter and pagination

tools.name: list_tiktok_ad_accounts
tools.description: List TikTok advertiser accounts for a connected credential

tools.name: list_tiktok_adgroups
tools.description: List TikTok ad groups within a campaign

tools.name: list_tiktok_ads
tools.description: List TikTok ads, optionally narrowed to a single ad group. Returns creative details alongside each ad

tools.name: list_tiktok_campaigns
tools.description: List TikTok ad campaigns for an advertiser account

tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Start a new agent conversation

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a message in an existing agent conversation

tools.name: analyze_performance
tools.description: Analyze recent content performance over the last 30 days. Returns engagement rates grouped by content type, platform, and posting time, plus top-performing posts.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get organization analytics, a post analytics snapshot, or analytics for the latest published post related to a selected content item.

tools.name: get_content_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for a specific piece of content (article, video, or image)

tools.name: get_linkedin_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for LinkedIn posts including impressions, engagement rate, reactions, comments, and shares. Requires a content ID.

tools.name: get_linkedin_connection_status
tools.description: Check whether a LinkedIn account is connected for the current user. Returns connection status, handle, and avatar if connected.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Get trending topics and content ideas based on current trends across social media and news.

tools.name: get_video_analytics
tools.description: Get detailed analytics for a specific video

tools.name: create_article_draft
tools.description: Import a complete reviewed HTML article into the connected organization as an unpublished draft. Preserves supplied content without generation. Use get_article_preview to review, then publish_article separately.

tools.name: get_article_preview
tools.description: Get an expiring signed preview URL for an owned article in the connected organization. Treat the URL as a bearer credential; do not send it to analytics or logs.

tools.name: publish_article
tools.description: Publish an owned reviewed article on the public website. Requires approval. Use get_articles and get_article_preview before requesting publication. Changes publication status without regenerating the body or replacing an existing publication date.

tools.name: create_brand_from_url
tools.description: Create a brand from a website URL with a draft guide and analyzed voice. Organization owners and admins only. Costs one credit on success. Set approve explicitly to approve the guide. Poll get_brand_scan_status if scanStatus is running.

tools.name: get_brand_completeness
tools.description: Get the current brand context completeness score and a list of fields that still have gaps. Read-only, no credits charged.

tools.name: get_brand_context
tools.description: Show everything the agent knows about a brand: the exact context injected into chat — identity, guidelines, voice, strategy and topics, persona, prompt seeds and conversation starters, performance insights, proven patterns, retrieved knowledge, recent posts, saved memories, active skills, the chat model with its credits per round, the context budget, and the rendered system prompt. Read-only, no credits charged. Use when the user asks what you know about their brand or why you wrote something a certain way.

tools.name: get_brand_scan_status
tools.description: Read the current website scan, guide revision and completeness for a brand created from a URL.

tools.name: list_brand_publishing_readiness
tools.description: List a brand connected publishing channels with credential ID, schedulability, health, and diagnostics. Read-only; check before scheduling.

tools.name: skip_brand_interview_question
tools.description: Skip the current interview question (e.g. the user doesn't know or wants to skip). Returns the next question and updated progress.

tools.name: start_brand_interview
tools.description: Start a brand context interview for the given brand. Charges 10 credits once (idempotent — resuming an active session does not re-charge). Returns the first question to ask the user, plus progress and completeness info.

tools.name: submit_brand_interview_answer
tools.description: Submit the user's answer to the current interview question. Pass the interviewId from start_brand_interview. Returns the next question (if any) and updated progress.

tools.name: analyze_clip_project
tools.description: Analyze a YouTube video for viral highlights: downloads audio, transcribes, and LLM-detects segments (1 credit). Poll with get_clip_project or get_clip_highlights.

tools.name: create_clip_project_from_youtube
tools.description: Create a clip project from a YouTube URL and run the AI clip factory async (1 credit/clip). HeyGen/Argil need avatarId+voiceId; GenfeedAI needs a brand character reference. Poll get_clip_project.

tools.name: generate_clips
tools.description: Generate clips from selected highlights (1 credit/clip). Avatar: avatarId+voiceId (HeyGen/Argil) or character ref (GenfeedAI); raw-cut: neither.

tools.name: get_clip_highlights
tools.description: Get the detected highlights for a clip project after analysis. Returns the highlights array plus the project's current status.

tools.name: get_clip_project
tools.description: Read a clip project by ID: status, progress, highlights, and generated clip results (with playable video URLs when ready). Poll this after analyze or generate.

tools.name: list_clip_projects
tools.description: List clip projects in your organization, most recent first. Returns id, name, status, and progress for each.

tools.name: open_in_editor
tools.description: Open existing videos in the Studio Editor. Creates a draft Editor project seeded with sourceVideoIds in order (one clip each, up to 50) and returns its id and /studio/editor path. Does not generate, render, or publish.

tools.name: complete_media_upload
tools.description: Finalize a presigned media upload. Returns assetId and, when available, the hosted URL. Pass assetId as create_scheduled_release media[].assetId or as create_post contentId / ingredientId. Pass the hosted URL as create_post mediaUrls.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a post draft from text, or prepare direct publishing for an existing content item or ingredient. The in-app agent returns a publish confirmation card first and publishes only after confirmed is set. On MCP this never publishes: confirmed is rejected, and publishing uses create_scheduled_release.

tools.name: generate_content
tools.description: Generate content for a topic or brief. Social types (caption, post, thread, script, article_outline) return ready-to-publish text with hook, body, CTA and hashtags and are not saved; use platform linkedin for LinkedIn posts and variationsCount for alternatives. type newsletter creates a saved newsletter draft. type article (or x-article) generates and saves an article draft with an id, ready for get_article_preview and publish_article; to import an already written article without regeneration use create_article_draft. Each field lists the types it applies to.

tools.name: generate_content_batch
tools.description: Generate a batch of content (images, videos, carousels) for a brand. Specify count, platforms, and date range. Use handle param to resolve @username to a credential. Returns a batch ID for tracking. Credits scale by item format and caption model tier — not a flat fee.

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Get one article by articleId, or search published articles by query (optionally filtered by category). Pass exactly one of articleId or query.

tools.name: get_posts
tools.description: Read posts. postId returns one post (exclusive with the other fields). days returns the content calendar for the coming days: scheduled and draft posts with gap analysis showing days without content. With neither, lists recent posts, optionally filtered by executionState and capped by limit. Post items carry channel target, execution state, media, and timestamps.

tools.name: get_x_posts
tools.description: Read X posts. postIdOrUrl opens one post and returns its text and stats. query searches recent posts by topic through the brand's connected X account and returns author, text, stats, and link; it explains clearly if that account cannot search. Pass exactly one of postIdOrUrl or query.

tools.name: repurpose_post
tools.description: Repurpose an existing post into a draft for another channel. Deterministic mode adapts the caption instantly through the channel capability catalog (length, hashtags, links, media compatibility); agent mode rewrites it with the content engine and lands the draft in the review queue. Never publishes or schedules anything.

tools.name: request_media_upload
tools.description: Reserve a pending asset for the selected brand and return uploadUrl, assetId, method, and constraints. For PUT, send file bytes with the returned headers. For POST_JSON, send localUpload as JSON, adding base64 file bytes in localUpload.source.data. Then call complete_media_upload. Does not publish or attach the file.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find tools this server offers, including ones outside the current ?toolsets= selection. No arguments: list toolsets with descriptions and tool counts. query and/or toolset: search tools by name, description, or toolset. name: describe one tool with its full input schema, toolset, mutation policy, credit cost, and required role.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get account details in one call: profile (user, organization, scoped brand, role, isOnboardingCompleted), credits (current balance) and usage (balance, 7 and 30 day credit spend, trend and spend breakdown by source). Defaults to all three; pass include to fetch fewer.

tools.name: get_brands
tools.description: Read the organization's brands. Without brand it lists every brand with name, description and tone profile. With brand it returns that one brand, matched by id, slug, name or label. When more than one brand exists, pass the chosen brand's id as brandId to other tools; the first brand is never used implicitly.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status and result of any generation (image, video, voice, music) by the id generate returned. Auto-detects content type.

tools.name: onboard_brand
tools.description: Set up a new account brand inside this conversation. Use it when get_account reports profile.isOnboardingCompleted false, before generating anything. Steps: (1) scan_url with one public URL the user gives (website, social profile, link page or product page) to prefill name, description, voice, colors and logo; if the scan fails, ask for another URL. (2) Ask the user, one question at a time, for goals, platforms, posting cadence and any tone adjustment, then save_answers. (3) complete once the user confirms the brand.

tools.name: resolve_approval
tools.description: Approve or decline a pending MCP write action that was queued for human review, executing it on approval. Pass the approvalId returned by the original (pending) tool call. Superadmin-only.

tools.name: enhance_prompt
tools.description: Preview a media prompt using the same Enhance implementation as Studio and Agent, with effective organization/brand settings and contributing pack metadata. Does not generate media. To generate the reviewed prompt unchanged, pass the returned prompt with harness:false. Model compilation during normal generation may add format-specific instructions; the generation receipt records the final submitted prompt.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate an image, video, voice (text-to-speech) or music track. Set type; a parameter marked for another type is rejected. Omit model to let the router pick the best available model. Image and video results include generationHarness with the exact submitted prompt and enhancement status: show that prompt with the result instead of reconstructing it.

tools.name: get_generation_options
tools.description: Read what generation can do right now: the effective image/video prompt enhancement settings with organization or brand overrides (settings, always returned), plus the Studio credit estimate and organization balance (cost, only when type is given). Returns the same catalog estimate the Generate composer shows and the same Genfeed balance as the credits bar. Does not charge credits, change a price, or authorize a generation. Omit modelKey, or pass Auto, for estimate status auto. Unsupported, missing, unpriced or voice and music types return estimate status unavailable with credits null. balance is null when the wallet cannot be read; a numeric 0 is a real empty balance. Threaded Agent calls use the validated current thread brand; brandId must match it. In threadless MCP calls, brandId selects the brand scope for settings.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List library assets of one type, newest first, for one brand: brandId, else the thread brand, else your current brand; with none of those it lists the whole organization. Failed, archived and rejected assets are left out. Types image, video, music and avatar return id, category, status, url, label or prompt, origin, tags (id and label) and createdAt. Type character lists the active named characters the brand can use, including characters another organization granted to yours for use only (handle, label, description, whether a reference image exists, and who granted it). A revoked grant disappears on the next call.

tools.name: set_generation_settings
tools.description: Set organization or brand prompt enhancement. Use null to restore inheritance. Threaded Agent calls use the validated current thread brand; brandId must match it. In threadless MCP calls, brandId selects the brand scope. Generation pricing is unchanged.

tools.name: transform_media
tools.description: Change existing media or join clips. operation edit: apply an exact instruction to a Library image (the original stays unchanged; imageId is the primary source, references adds up to four ordered images for Ideogram or nine for FLUX.3; FLUX.3 supports one output, resolution and aspectRatio, with no mask or seed; optional maskId must match the primary dimensions, black changes and white stays; uses the image-editing category default, never the generation model; do not enhance or rewrite the instruction). operation reframe: re-crop an image to a new aspect ratio. operation upscale: upscale an image to higher resolution from its URL. operation merge: join two or more existing videos into one clip with transitions, captions, resizing, mute and background music; slideshow zoom (zoomEaseCurve and zoomConfigs) is not supported and is rejected before any merge starts. Each field lists the operations it applies to; a field for another operation is rejected. Edit, reframe and upscale spend credits through the shared generation settlement; merge runs locally and is free.

tools.name: attach_remix_analysis_source
tools.description: Select an eligible same-brand USER Library video for scene analysis, or clear with null. The selected Library media is analyzed; the original imported URL remains provenance. This does not infer permission or start paid analysis.

tools.name: control_remix_generation
tools.description: Cancel or resume an existing canonical video/avatar scene pipeline after approval. Image/copy control is unsupported; resume retains canonical quote and billing checks.

tools.name: create_remix_concept
tools.description: Create or reuse a canonical saved remix concept from an imported source post for an explicit brand. Saving does not generate or publish.

tools.name: create_storyboard_remix
tools.description: Create a storyboard run from an owned Library video. Does not generate, quote, or charge credits.

tools.name: get_instagram_inspiration_detail
tools.description: Fetch latest or top public posts from one Instagram account and return provenance plus abstract hook, format, pacing, and style signals.

tools.name: get_remix_run
tools.description: Read the canonical remix revision, source lineage, saved concept, quotes, scene state, receipts and generated artifacts. Safe to repeat after reconnecting.

tools.name: get_tiktok_top_performers
tools.description: Get top performing TikTok ads sorted by a specific metric (CTR, CPC, spend, etc.)

tools.name: import_source_post
tools.description: Import a supported public X, Instagram or TikTok post into Imported sources for an explicit brand. Returns source/post identities and deduplication. Requires approval for external import; never generates, publishes or adds Knowledge.

tools.name: list_instagram_inspiration
tools.description: Discover public Instagram accounts and content patterns relevant to the selected brand niche.

tools.name: quote_remix_generation
tools.description: Save a concrete generation quote for this revision without dispatch. Image requires an explicit model; copy uses its canonical model. Video/avatar uses scene analysis, generate or repair quotes and rejects model. Inspect the quote before approval. BYOK can still incur external provider costs.

tools.name: replace_storyboard_character
tools.description: Replace the character in one storyboard shot using Higgsfield Genjutsu motion transfer. Does not preserve source audio, does not guarantee lip-sync, and does not charge credits while the catalog row is inactive at cost 0.

tools.name: start_remix_generation
tools.description: Execute the exact persisted quote and revision after explicit approval. Routes by canonical output/quote; repeated accepted execution retrieves the same run rather than buying another attempt.

tools.name: storyboard_run_capabilities
tools.description: Read the current brand-scoped storyboard video model, supported durations, interpolation eligibility and capability version without generating or changing defaults.

tools.name: update_remix_concept
tools.description: Save canonical concept and recipe edits at the expected revision. Stale revisions fail; does not generate or replace the imported source.

tools.name: archive_knowledge_source
tools.description: Archive a Knowledge source so it never appears in retrieval again. Its receipts on past outputs are kept.

tools.name: assign_knowledge_purpose
tools.description: Change the purpose of a Knowledge source (Brand Truth, Inspiration, Research) and optionally hide it from retrieval.

tools.name: capture_knowledge
tools.description: Save a page, document, feed, media or pasted text into the brand Knowledge library and start ingestion. Pass sourceId to refresh an existing URL or RSS source. Default purpose is INSPIRATION; pass BRAND_TRUTH only for material the brand owns and vouches for.

tools.name: list_knowledge_sources
tools.description: List the brand Knowledge sources with their purpose, processing state and failure reason.

tools.name: read_knowledge_source
tools.description: Read one Knowledge source: metadata, current version state, provenance, a bounded text preview and the spaces it belongs to.

tools.name: retry_knowledge_ingestion
tools.description: Requeue ingestion for a Knowledge source whose last attempt failed. Never creates a duplicate.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the brand Knowledge library (saved pages, documents and notes) and return cited passages with their source, purpose and relevance. Use it before writing anything that must be accurate about the brand.

tools.name: connect_social_account
tools.description: Start a resumable social-account connection. Returns a connectionId and browser authorization URL. Poll get_connection_status until authorized.

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Get connection status for a social platform or a durable connection request id. Safe to poll.

tools.name: initiate_oauth_connect
tools.description: Start connecting a social account and return a durable connection request plus a connect button.

tools.name: control_scheduled_release
tools.description: Control a scheduled release lifecycle: cancel, pause, resume, or publish now.

tools.name: create_scheduled_release
tools.description: Create a multi-channel scheduled release.

tools.name: get_scheduled_release
tools.description: Get one scheduled release by ID: channel targets, validation/execution state, attachments, recurrence, and transition history.

tools.name: get_scheduler_capabilities
tools.description: Scheduler channel capabilities: caption limits, media rules, publish modes, required settings, status. Pass platform for one channel; omit it to list every channel. Read-only.

tools.name: update_scheduled_release
tools.description: Update a release or a target.

tools.name: validate_scheduler_target
tools.description: Validate a proposed target against the channel-capability contract; returns errors/warnings/validationState. Read-only.

tools.name: archive_skill
tools.description: Uninstall a skill the caller governs.

tools.name: create_skill
tools.description: Create a personal, organization, or brand skill. The default owner is the caller.

tools.name: export_skill
tools.description: Export instruction text when the caller is allowed to export it.

tools.name: fork_skill
tools.description: Fork a skill into the caller personal library.

tools.name: install_skills_pro_skill
tools.description: Install one entitled Skills Pro pack into the authenticated organization runtime after integrity verification.

tools.name: publish_skill
tools.description: Publish the current skill version to the organization or publicly.

tools.name: rollback_skill
tools.description: Restore a governed skill to an earlier captured version. A Skills Pro reinstall is the update path.

tools.name: verify_skills_pro_entitlement
tools.description: Verify a Skills Pro receipt for the authenticated organization and list the exact skill slugs it grants.

tools.name: approve_social_draft
tools.description: Approve a social inbox draft and publish it externally as a reply or DM. Requires approval before execution.

tools.name: assign_social_conversation
tools.description: Assign or unassign a social inbox conversation.

tools.name: create_social_reply_draft
tools.description: Create a draft reply or DM in the social inbox for later approval. This does not send externally.

tools.name: get_social_conversation
tools.description: Get one social inbox conversation and, by default, its recent messages.

tools.name: list_social_conversations
tools.description: List social inbox conversations across connected YouTube and Instagram accounts, with filters for review state, assignee, tags, and platform.

tools.name: list_x_account_activity
tools.description: List recent posts from an X account. Uses the brand's connected account when no username is given.

tools.name: mark_social_conversation_resolved
tools.description: Mark a social inbox conversation as resolved.

tools.name: post_social_reply
tools.description: Publish a reply in a social inbox conversation. Requires approval before execution.

tools.name: reject_social_draft
tools.description: Reject a social inbox draft without publishing it externally.

tools.name: send_social_dm
tools.description: Send a direct message from a social inbox conversation. Requires approval before execution.

tools.name: tag_social_conversation
tools.description: Replace tags on a social inbox conversation.

tools.name: cancel_visual_code_project
tools.description: Request cancellation of the current visual revision. Consumed work is charged and unused held credits are released.

tools.name: export_visual_code_project
tools.description: Export retained source to MP4, PNG or JPEG Library outputs using an approved quote and expectedRevision.

tools.name: generate_visual_code
tools.description: Create a versioned visual project from a prompt or directly supplied React/Remotion source. Requires a prior quote and approved maximumCredits. Untrusted code runs only in an isolated renderer; completed outputs enter the brand Library.

tools.name: get_visual_code_catalog
tools.description: List available visual-code models, rendering limits, rates and inspection support for this brand.

tools.name: get_visual_code_project
tools.description: Read visual project revision history, diagnostics, costs, previews and completed Library outputs. Source is available through the authenticated source download.

tools.name: quote_visual_code_generation
tools.description: Quote a visual-code request without spending credits. Show the selected model, inspection uncertainty, output formats and maximum credits before requesting approval.

tools.name: retry_visual_code_project
tools.description: Explicitly retry retained source from a failed or cancelled visual revision using a new requestId and approved quote. No automatic source repair occurs; inspect prior diagnostics for uncertain provider work.

tools.name: revise_visual_code_project
tools.description: Create an immutable visual revision using exactly one prompt, sourceCode or props change and an approved quote. expectedRevision prevents overwriting newer work.

tools.name: create_ad_remix_workflow
tools.description: Create a draft, review-only ad remix workflow from a selected public or connected ad. This never launches an ad.

tools.name: create_instagram_remix_workflow
tools.description: Create a draft, review-only Instagram remix workflow that adapts a public post pattern to the selected brand. This is prompt-based reinterpretation, not video style transfer.

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a workflow: direct graph, a recurring scaffold, or natural-language generation. Editable in the Workflows app.

tools.name: duplicate_workflow
tools.description: Duplicate a workflow into the current organization and brand scope so the copy can be edited or scheduled without mutating the source workflow.

tools.name: execute_workflow
tools.description: Execute an existing workflow immediately. Select nodeIds to rerun edited steps while reusing locked outputs; pass required variables for full or partial execution.

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.description: Inspect a single workflow run, including status, trigger, node results, progress, timing, errors, and metadata.

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.description: Get the current status and progress of a workflow, including step completion details.

tools.name: inspect_workflow
tools.description: Inspect one workflow, including schedule, lifecycle, inputs, graph summary, and immutable system-workflow metadata when present.

tools.name: install_system_workflow
tools.description: Install one system workflow catalog entry into the current organization as an editable, schedulable copy. Installing the same entry twice returns the existing workflow.

tools.name: list_system_workflow_catalog
tools.description: List the code-owned Genfeed system workflow catalog with per-organization install state. Use this to discover official automations before installing one.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List workflow run history with optional workflow, status, trigger, limit, and offset filters.

tools.name: list_workflow_templates
tools.description: List available workflow templates that can be used to quickly create new workflows.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List all workflows in your organization with optional status filtering.

tools.name: set_workflow_schedule
tools.description: Enable, disable, or update the schedule on an editable workflow duplicate. Disabling requires no new cron expression when the workflow already has one.
